build_task_scene: build a PHYRE task scene with a jar, obstacle bar, and ball using the creator library
add_dynamic_jar: create a dynamic jar object centered in the scene with a calculated scale and bottom position
add_static_obstacle: add a static bar obstacle above the jar with a fixed scale relative to scene width
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball positioned to the left of the obstacle and above its top edge
update_task_relationship: define the task goal by setting the ball and jar with an INSIDE spatial relationship
